one_line: Nvidia faces executive leadership turmoil and political scrutiny, SoftBank takes major financial write-offs, and new AI models and tools are released.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership crisis and China controls
themes.text: Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang following reports of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, prompting congressional subpoenas, document preservation requests, and stock drops. Meanwhile, the U.S. Commerce Department finalized rules to block remote AI chip access for China as Chinese firms rush to secure overseas compute capacity.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock drops as board reportedly prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang
Senators ask Trump administration to preserve Nvidia-China records
House Republicans push for Nvidia's Jensen Huang to testify over spy allegations
Commerce Department finalizes rule to block remote AI chip access for China
Chinese AI firms rush to secure overseas Nvidia compute capacity amid US curb fears
Nvidia board prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang amid scandal
Megaspeed founder Alice Huang returns to Beijing
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue after July 2025 blocklist
Congress prepares subpoena for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over spy affair

themes.title: SoftBank records write-offs and robotics investments
themes.text: SoftBank wrote off $3.7 billion from unused gas turbines intended for AI data centers alongside a $1.3 billion loss on OpenAI warrants, while leading a $500 million funding round for robotics maker Agile Robots.

stories.headline: SoftBank writes off $3.7B from unused gas turbines for AI data centres
Agile Robots raises $500M led by SoftBank at $8.5B valuation

themes.title: New models and AI-built tools
themes.text: Google DeepMind released the AlphaGenome 2 DNA sequence model and the Gemini Decisions API, while AWS launched an emulator built entirely by AI agents without human-written code.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind announces AlphaGenome 2 DNA sequence model
AWS releases AWS Emulator built entirely by AI agents
Google launches Gemini Decisions API for fast multimodal yes/no and choice scoring

themes.title: Infrastructure funding and industry updates
themes.text: CoreWeave plans a $4 billion investment-grade loan after raising its revenue forecast, chip startup Fractile raised $720 million at a $7 billion valuation, and Torus raised $500 million for modular container-sized data centers. Anthropic's IPO drew multiple times the available shares, xAI faces legal accountability efforts over Grok deepfakes, and United Airlines barred unauthorized third-party AI booking agents.

stories.headline: CoreWeave plans $4B+ investment-grade loan after raising revenue forecast
UK-backed AI chip startup Fractile hits $7 billion valuation
Torus raises $500M to build modular container-sized AI data centers
Anthropic IPO draws multiple times the orders for available shares
